fields.text: Asked on the board; the form above records your answer here.

Got it: chasing 0.16.3 linuxu in a time-boxed lane (unikraft-linuxu). The pinned 0.21.0 has no linuxu, so the lane pins 0.16.3 beside it, tries a smaller reservation first, and records a stall honestly if the platform cannot map the runtime.
